title: Bot Mode Topology
brief: Clean technical architecture diagram, light cream background. Left column: a folder drawer titled '~/.hermes/profiles/' containing three labeled profile folders: 'researcher', 'writer', 'ops', each showing tiny icons for memory / skills / credentials. Middle: an arrow labeled 'Bot = profile' leading to a roster panel with three named bot cards each with a distinct simple avatar face, titled 'Bot 花名册 · canonical Bot Chat（永不分叉）'. Flat vector infographic style, thin lines, terracotta orange and ink blue accents, bilingual Chinese labels with English technical terms.
